numerical_failure.observed_behavior: Setting a NA-free nullable/ArrowDtype extension array into an incompatible NumPy-dtype column silently stores wrong values: a negative value (-1) into an unsigned-integer column wraps to 18446744073709551615 (2**64-1), and a value overflowing a narrower float dtype silently becomes inf (e.g. 1e300 -> inf).
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: The assignment should raise (LossySetitemError internally, surfacing as an error on setitem) instead of silently wrapping or overflowing; a fitting value still assigns inplace.
trigger_conditions: Setting a no-NA nullable EA (Int64) or ArrowDtype (int64[pyarrow]) array into a NumPy-dtype column via setitem such as Series.iloc
Signed EA holding a negative value assigned into an unsigned-integer column
Float64 or double[pyarrow] value overflowing a narrower target float dtype
Array contains no NA values (NA-containing arrays already raise LossySetitemError)
